title: Signposts
learn: Guide your listener with "first, next, finally."

pages.title: Signposts
pages.body: Signposts are like mile markers. They tell your listener exactly where they are in your story so they don't get lost.
pages.learn: Guide your listener with "first, next, finally."

steps.label: Preview
steps.text: Give an internal preview to let listeners know what is coming up next.

steps.label: Signpost
steps.text: Use brief terms like First, Next, and Finally to show movement through your content.

steps.label: Sum Up
steps.text: Use an internal summary to remind the audience of what they just heard.

pages.title: Before and after
pages.situation: Explaining how to make a sandwich.
pages.before: Get bread. Put jam on it. Eat it.
pages.after: I'll show you in three steps. First, get bread. Next, put jam on it. Finally, eat it. To sum up, that is how you make a sandwich.
pages.why: It uses a preview, clear signposts, and a summary.

pages.title: Why it works
pages.body: Clear organization helps the audience listen for main points, which leads to higher retention of your message.

quiz.q: Which phrase best serves as an internal preview before starting a presentation?
options: In summary, we discussed three points.
I will outline three main steps.
First, let's look at the data.
quiz.explain: Previews let listeners know what is coming up next.

quiz.q: You have just finished explaining a complex point. What should you do to help the audience?
quiz.explain: Summaries remind the audience of what they just heard.

quiz.q: Which sequence correctly uses signposts to show movement through content?
quiz.explain: These terms show movement through the speech content.

examples.student: I'll explain my thesis in three parts. First, I'll cover the data collection; next, the analysis; and finally, the results. So, that covers the methodology and the outcome.
examples.job_seeker: I'll highlight three key achievements. First, I grew sales by 20%; next, I led a team of five; and finally, I streamlined our CRM. In short, I bring growth, leadership, and efficiency.
examples.customer_facing: I'll show you how to use this device in three steps. First, plug it in; next, sync the app; and finally, press start. To recap, it's just plug, sync, and start.
examples.creator: In this video, I'll show you how to bake this cake. First, we prep the oven; next, we mix ingredients; and finally, we frost it. Now that we've baked and frosted, let's taste it.
examples.everyday: I'll tell you how to get to the park. First, go straight; next, turn left at the light; and finally, it's on your right. So, straight, left, and then you're there.
examples.new_here: I'll explain my move in three stages. First, the visa process; next, the house hunt; and finally, finding a job. So, that was my journey from applying to working here.

student.setup: You are presenting your research plan for the semester.
student.opening: Can you walk me through your research process step-by-step? I tend to lose the thread if the logic isn't very clear.

job_seeker.setup: You are answering a behavioral question about your previous experience.
job_seeker.opening: Could you explain exactly how you handled that project from start to finish? I get lost easily with long stories.

customer_facing.setup: You are helping a client set up a complex piece of software.
customer_facing.opening: I'm not tech-savvy and I get confused quickly. Can you walk me through the setup process one step at a time?

creator.setup: You are planning the structure of a tutorial video together.
creator.opening: Can you walk me through the sequence of the tutorial? I get lost if the flow isn't explicitly mapped out.

everyday.setup: You are giving directions to a local hidden gem in the neighborhood.
everyday.opening: Could you tell me how to get there step-by-step? I have a terrible sense of direction and get lost easily.

new_here.setup: You are sharing your experience of relocating to the city.
new_here.opening: I've always wondered how people move countries. Can you walk me through the steps you took? I get lost in the details.
